data.name: ExternalRouteText.CaboABDoisPares
data.value: Cable A+B — two independent pairs. Simultaneous operation is unavailable. 1. Note your original selections. In the Windows 11 Volume mixer, or in App volume and device preferences on Windows 10, select the Cable A playback device for the browser only. The intended path is browser → Cable A → DSP → headset. 2. In OBS, add a single Audio Input Capture source for the Cable B capture device. The intended path is microphone → DSP → Cable B → OBS source. Leave monitoring off and avoid duplicating the source in global settings. 3. Confirm that each route has stopped and released its devices, then restore your original selections.

data.name: ExternalRouteText.CaboSimplesDoisFluxosSequenciais
data.value: Single cable — two routes run in sequence. Simultaneous operation is unavailable. 1. Note your original selections. In the Windows 11 Volume mixer, or in App volume and device preferences on Windows 10, select the cable playback device for the browser only. The intended path is browser → cable → DSP → headset. 2. Once the route has stopped, stop the test signal and restore the browser's original output. Verify that the cable is silent and no other sources are sending audio to it before switching routes. 3. In OBS, add a single Audio Input Capture source for the cable capture device. The intended path is microphone → DSP → cable → OBS source. Leave monitoring off and avoid duplicating the source in global settings. Restore the original selection once the route has stopped.
